scope: Research only; no production changes, sharing changes, or user actions.

access.method: Authenticated direct paginated folder listing, then raw file fetch with inline base64 disabled; actual video bytes mounted in execution container.
access.priorFailure: Search query returned folders but omitted files. Direct listing returned original and four split recordings. Exact cause of search omission not established.

segments.review: 15 representative timestamps at 10-second spacing show active battle and result scenes; no preview seen in these samples, not exhaustive manual ground truth.

Visual inspection of all 24 emitted frames: 22 show the same apparent opponent preview lineup (15–86.5 nominal seconds); two show in-battle command menus (112 and 122 nominal seconds). Thus 132 preview candidate crops and 12 false-scene candidate crops, not validated individual crop accuracy. All remain quarantined.

limitations: One apparent lineup in a single recording; no independent species label checks, no ground truth for all sampled frames, no overall sensitivity/specificity estimate.
Candidate run count is inflated by intermittent geometry detection; unique SHA-256 is not meaningful appearance independence.
First and last split segments must not be treated as independent matches; middle segments not scanned.
Decode end or error is not distinguished by collector; samples consistent with nominal frame counts, not proof of exhaustive decoding.
No raw recordings, crops, trainer identifiers, lineups, Drive identifiers or bearer URLs committed.
